title: The Unexpected Orchard
author: Felix Underhill
blurb: Emrys Iversen, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
